Asobi 1.0 (build 1104) Oct 1, 2026

  • Choose how long a showcase lasts: 1 month, 6 months, 12 months, or until you delete it. Web review links last 7 days, or longer if you choose.
  • Extend a running review or showcase from the Review Manager. The links you've already sent keep working.
  • Who watched is kept for good, even after a showcase ends, until you choose Delete Viewing Records… in the Review Manager.
  • Small fixes and improvements.
Earlier updates

1.0 (build 1099) Oct 1, 2026

  • The studio watcher works away from the studio. Reviews you host from home or on the road are registered with it too.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1097) Oct 1, 2026

  • Studio Reviews opens straight away. Every review is checked at once and rows fill in as they answer, instead of a spinner while each is read in turn.
  • Every shared review is registered with the studio watcher. The setting is now on for everyone. To turn it off on your Mac, ask an admin.
  • Gentler reconnecting. A review that keeps dropping the connection is retried less and less often, not every second.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1091) Sep 30, 2026

  • The PDF manual reads properly again. Pictures in the later chapters (Showcases, Check Frames, Sharing, Network) print at the right size, and the Showcases steps are numbered in order.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1085) Sep 30, 2026

  • The manual is up to date. New chapters on Showcases and Check Frames, with new pictures throughout. Help ▸ Asobi Manual has the PDF too.
  • Showcases: a showcase made straight after ending a web link now opens as it should. Clip names on the opening screen drop version numbers and read more cleanly. An ended showcase now says the showcase has ended.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1080) Sep 30, 2026

  • Check Frames. Review ▸ Check Frames… reads every frame of the clip on screen and lists the ones that look wrong. Serious: missing or unreadable files, files cut short, a different size, NaN or infinite pixels. Worth a look: a different format, black, white or flat frames, a one-frame color or brightness jump, a broken patch, a repeated frame. Each flag says why, and a click goes to the frame. Add as Notes puts each one in the review, and Export CSV… saves the list. Frames are compared with their neighbors, so a cut, a fade or a held black isn’t flagged. Image sequences get every check. QuickTimes get the picture checks.
  • From the command line: Asobi checkframes <clip or folder> [--strict] [--csv out.csv] gives the same report, for a delivery folder or a nightly job.
  • An ended showcase’s link now says the showcase has ended, not the review.

1.0 (build 1074) Sep 30, 2026

  • Showcases have their own window. Make Showcase opens the Showcase window. It has a yellow accent, the steps as it’s made, who can watch, the link, Email…, Copy for Email, Preview, Save GIF…, the people you named, See Who Watched… and End Showcase. Nothing from a review is mixed in. The Share window just points to it. To come back to it, choose Review ▸ Showcase Window.
  • Reels of several clips. A showcase with more than one clip shows each clip’s thumbnail, name and length on its opening screen. It has a Clips button for jumping between clips while it plays, and one timeline across the whole reel. The closing card offers “Watch another”. The Review Manager’s Viewing shows each clip: how many viewers reached it and how much of it they watched.
  • Skippable sign-in. When anyone with the link can watch, you can let viewers skip giving their name and email. Visits that skip are still counted, marked “skipped sign-in”. Your choice is remembered for the next showcase.

1.0 (build 1070) Sep 30, 2026

  • Showcases always open. Make Showcase now gives each showcase a room of its own. A new showcase could pick up the previous room’s key, and its page then said “isn’t available”. Ending a review and reopening it no longer leaves it locked to everyone.
  • Viewers can sign in with their email. Make Showcase asks who can watch: anyone with the link, who signs in with their name and email before it plays (the default), or only the people you name, one link each. The People field takes email addresses.
  • You can see what happens next. After Make Showcase, the Share window shows each step (preparing, uploading, making the email preview) and then what to do: Email…, Copy for Email, Preview and Save GIF….
  • Email you can edit. Email… opens a new Mail message with the recipient and subject filled in. Press ⌘V in it to add the moving preview, linked to the showcase, with the caption and link. The Review Manager’s Links menu says what each item did.
  • Reopened showcases stay showcases, with your Preview link. Reopening a review no longer forgets who opened it, app requests, deliveries or brief receipts.

Asobi 1.0 (build 1099)

  • The studio watcher works away from the studio. Reviews you host from home or on the road are registered with it too.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

Asobi 1.0 (build 1097)

  • Studio Reviews opens straight away. Every review is checked at once and rows fill in as they answer, instead of a spinner while each is read in turn.
  • Every shared review is registered with the studio watcher. The setting is now on for everyone. To turn it off on your Mac, ask an admin.
  • Gentler reconnecting. A review that keeps dropping the connection is retried less and less often, not every second.
  • Small fixes and improvements.
